newsitem.title: FRANCE: Beserk man kills French policeman, wounds five.
newsitem.headline: Beserk man kills French policeman, wounds five.

text.p: A man shot dead a police captain and wounded five other officers after going beserk in woods near the southern French town of Montelimar on Thursday, police said.
The police said they were called in after the man, who lives in a shack in the woods, grabbed a shotgun from a hunter whom he accused of firing at game too close to his home.
They said the man opened fire when police officers arrived at the scene. An exchange of shots followed.
The man, whom they described as a social misfit, was arrested an hour later after more police were called out.
Two of the five wounded officers were in serious condition, police said.
